title: Bound evidence wire terms before outer copy
finding: G1-TENSOR-01AQ bounded the outer evidence alternatives sequence before tuple materialization, but EvidenceValue.from_dict still copied every outer alternative reference before EvidenceValue.__post_init__ inspected the first inner term. An oversized first term could therefore be known-invalid while later outer elements were still accessed/copied.
primary_claim: EvidenceValue.from_dict now validates each inner term length with the existing _bounded_sequence primitive while traversing the bounded outer sequence, so an oversized term fails closed before parsing advances to later alternatives. Constructor canonicalization remains the semantic authority.
gardener_decision: Extend the existing wire-boundary validation path and existing adversarial evidence-bound test surface. Do not add a codec layer, parser object, second evidence schema, or backend abstraction.
acceptance: an oversized first evidence term is rejected from its declared length before any atom access
wire parsing does not advance to later alternatives after the first oversized term
MAX_EVIDENCE_ALTERNATIVES and MAX_EVIDENCE_TERM_ATOMS remain the single outer and inner evidence bounds
normal EvidenceValue canonicalization and round trips remain unchanged
no new backend, persistence authority, semantic plane, OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01AR commits; no Forest/Fourfold authority or persisted schema changes are involved.
